structure: Part 5, Address book. Read in full: e2e/address-book.fit.spec.js (239 lines; 3 describes, 9 tests: 'address book list' with 1 test 'categories, pagination and filters' in 7 steps; 'add an address to the address book' with 6 tests: choose an address type, origin or consignor entered by hand, destination/consignee/importer found by postcode, branch, transporter hand-over, usage-step guard; 'an address book entry' with 2 tests: view/edit/save in 4 steps, and delete), e2e/support/journey.js (283 lines; this part claims only the shared helpers the address-book tests call: url/urlFor for the /design-release-2.1 mount, expectHeading on the first h1, expectErrorSummary with its 'There is a problem' title and exact ordered message list, expectBackLink, submitForm and clickAction) and e2e/support/fixtures.js (48 lines; records each test's main-frame navigations for the trace index, which is suite tooling and no prototype behaviour, so it gets no claim). Routes covered: /address-book (list, ?category=, ?page=2, search and type filter), /address-book/add, /address-book/add/lookup (and ?manual=true), /address-book/add/find-address, /address-book/add/find-address/select, /address-book/add/usage (guard only), /transporter/add (hand-over only), /address-book/<entry>, /address-book/<entry>/edit and /address-book/<entry>/delete.
